summary:
AFTERTRACE 3D is an interactive 3D space archive created to tell the stories of abandoned and forgotten NASA equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The project allows users to explore textured 3D representations of the Moon and Mars, rotate the planets, zoom in and out, and discover mission markers connected to historic space missions. By selecting these markers, users can explore mission records and access relevant NASA source links.

The project includes missions such as Apollo 11, Apollo 17, InSight, and Mars Pathfinder. It combines interactive 3D visualization with educational storytelling to help people understand the scientific legacy of space exploration and the hardware left behind on other worlds.

Built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js, AFTERTRACE 3D aims to make space history more engaging, accessible, and easy to explore.
